findings: The repository has no pre-existing C2 webhook receiver, GitHub ingress endpoint, durable event store, or policy registry.
The root src/ directory is absent; current source is split between contract/WIT, root scripts, winner/scripts, and winner/tests.
The only non-winner webhook search hit is a contract WIT comment describing host webhook dispatch; it is not an ingress implementation.
winner/scripts/c1-live.ts and historical C1 evidence mention causal webhook ingress only as a future capability or forbidden claim; they do not receive or authenticate GitHub events.
Existing C1 provider/DID scripts and evidence are execution-plane artifacts and were not promoted into source authentication or C2 authority logic.

selected_source.causal_statement: When authenticated GitHub secret_scanning_alert(created) event X for Ticoworld/t3n-breakglass-sandbox has secret_type openssh_private_key and matches pre-existing policy github-openssh-private-key-revoke-v1, BreakGlass may create exactly the deterministically derived C2 incident authorizing only revoke_github_deploy_key against deploy key 162351194.
selected_source.causality_boundary: The GitHub event proves an authenticated, uniquely identified repository security signal. The pre-existing policy, not the event body, supplies the exact action, target, TTL, agent DID, and broker DID.

target_derivation.repository_binding: policy target repository must equal policy repository identity and normalized authenticated repository

target_derivation.missing_or_invalid_target_behavior: A: do not produce a C1 create request and do not create an incident authority; persist a terminal C2_TARGET_NOT_BOUND decision

incident_derivation.formula: C2-<policy_id>-<SHA-256(policy_id + newline + policy_version + newline + raw_body_sha256) first 24 hex chars>

dedupe_semantics.NEW: exclusive durable reservation is created; only then may policy evaluation proceed
dedupe_semantics.DUPLICATE_SAME: same dedupe key and same raw-body digest return the existing durable decision/reference; no new authority is produced
dedupe_semantics.CONFLICT: same dedupe key but different authenticated raw-body digest fails closed and preserves the original record
dedupe_semantics.crash_after_reservation: retry sees RESERVED and can deterministically complete or terminally reject the same reservation; it cannot reserve a second authority for the delivery identity

ordering_and_replay.delayed_delivery: accepted only if the event time is after policy creation and policy is currently enabled/version-consistent
ordering_and_replay.after_terminal_closed: durable existing incident/reference is returned; no second C1 request is authorized
ordering_and_replay.wrong_repository: authenticated event is normalized but has no matching policy, no request
ordering_and_replay.valid_event_no_matching_policy: C2_NO_MATCHING_POLICY, durable terminal rejection, no request

claims_earned: A real GitHub-origin webhook event class was selected for a bounded causal vertical.

The generated C1 request cannot be changed by event-body target/action/TTL/DID text.
The causal incident ID is deterministic and persisted with source digest and policy version.
